title: Merge-index keeps a pre-schema-11 note edit clean after the retraction restamp
lead: s393 bumped the index schema to 11 and persists three empty retraction fields on every note record. The first save on main after landing rewrites every note record. A branch cut before s393 that only appends notes still merges cleanly, but one that edits or verifies an existing note now differs from main on that record and the `slicer-index` driver reports a conflict.
findings_note: s393 review 2026-10-30, later note: after the schema-11 restamp, a branch cut before s393 that edits or verifies an existing note conflicts on that note
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing what schema 11 persists; omitting empty fields.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The same exposure followed the schema-7 metadata bump. It costs a hand-resolved conflict in `.slicer/index.json` for any long-lived branch, which the merge driver exists to avoid.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/mergeindex.py`: `_note_records` (about lines 125-160). Compare note records with absent retraction fields and empty ones as equal, so an older side that lacks the keys counts as unchanged on them.
- `tests/test_merge_index.py`: a three-way case with a schema-10 base and ours, and a schema-11 theirs that only restamped.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_MergeIndex_OlderSideEditsNote_TheirsOnlyRestamped_MergesClean`: base and ours are schema 10, ours edits a note's text, theirs is the same note restamped with empty retraction fields. The merge takes ours' text with no conflict. It fails today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Normalize each note record to the current field set (missing optional fields as their empty default) before the three-way compare in `_note_records`.
2. Keep the output in the current schema and fixed key order.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch.
